centralized.name: Centralized AI (Traditional)
centralized.description: All patient records pooled into central server. High utility, catastrophic privacy risk.

federated_no_dp.name: Federated Learning (No DP)
federated_no_dp.description: Data stays local, but gradients are transmitted unperturbed.

federated_fixed_dp.name: Federated + Fixed DP
federated_fixed_dp.description: Constant Gaussian noise injection. Mathematically sound, but suffers utility drop.

federated_adaptive_dp.name: Federated + Novel Adaptive DP
federated_adaptive_dp.description: Dynamic noise decay schedule. Superior utility while preserving strong empirical privacy.
